It needs a worked Peat Cutting in the distilling city — the peat is cut and burned — so every such city makes on

CH05.name: Oxygen Theory
CH05.fx: +1 Production from all Forge buildings — combustion understood, so every furnace burns hotter. The systematic chemistry of Lavoisier's balance — elements, compounds, gases weighed — and the prerequisite for the Periodic Table.
CH05.flav: The older phlogiston account described this same chemistry through missing oxygen.

CH06.name: Periodic Table
CH06.fx: Research Lab; +1 Science from Strategic resource tiles in all cities (you finally know what you are looking at)
CH06.flav: You finally know what you're looking for.

CH07.name: Organic Chemistry
CH07.fx: Pharmaceutical Works 500/3; +2 Happiness, +2 Gold — medicines and synthetic dyes; Cristo Redentor (world wonder). Vitalist worlds keep refining but cannot create life's chemistry from dead matter.
CH07.flav: Mechanist worlds synthesise from anything; vitalist worlds work from what once lived — and grow the rest.

CH08.name: Explosives (non-gunpowder)
CH08.fx: Artillery (unit); -25% construction time for Mine improvements (blasting). The gunpowder-free explosive. Also discoverable through Mining.

CH09.name: Petrochemistry
CH09.fx: Refinery [690/4; +2 Production; +3 Gold; +1 Production from Oil tiles in this city; requires Oil; Remove Bio-Refinery in this city]. Requires Petroleum.

CH09-W.name: Bio-Organic Synthesis
CH09-W.fx: Bio-Refinery [375/2; +1 Production; +2 Gold; Remove Refinery in this city — plastics, sealants and fuel grown rather than drilled]. Slower and land-hungry, but renewable. The primary chemistry path in FOSSIL_FUELS_ABSENT worlds.
CH09-W.flav: Nature made polymers first. What if we learned from it better?

CH11.name: Polymer Science
CH11.fx: Infantry (unit); unlocks Materials Science focus (with ME12). +15% Production when constructing Land units in all cities — mass-produced uniforms and kit: nylon is a polymer.

CH12.name: Catalysis
CH12.fx: +1 Food from Farm tiles in all cities — the Haber process: the canonical Fertilizer bonus, earned by chemistry. Also discoverable through Farming. The primary of the fixed-nitrogen Competing Solution; Nitrate Fertiliser is its alternative.

CH13.name: Rocket Propellant
CH13.fx: Unlocks Rocketry focus; Propellant Works [125/1; +15% Production when constructing Siege units in this city]. Rocket Artillery, Mobile SAM (units — canonical Rocketry; Rocket Artillery requires Aluminum). The first rockets are weapons, made from the propellant itself.

CH14.name: Photochemistry
CH14.fx: Photography Studio [375/2; +2 Culture; Great Artist points 1; +25% spy effectiveness in this city (<when espionage is enabled>)]. Prerequisite for solar power.
CH14.conj: Light darkens salts of silver; perhaps it could be made to fix an image.

CH15.name: Greek Alchemical Tradition
CH15.fx: Alchemist's Guild 50/1; +2 Gold; reveals Distillation, and the acids it yields, as a concept centuries early. Alexandria's alchemists getting practical results.

CH19.name: Systematic Element Analysis
CH19.fx: Analytical Laboratory [national wonder; 200/0; +2 Science; on completion Triggers a Systematic Element Analysis event and Reveals the fork this world takes: the Periodic Table in Corpuscular worlds (~55%), Transmutation Practice in Substance-Elemental worlds (~25%), Five-Phase Theory in Process-Elemental worlds (~20%)].
CH19.flav: The question every natural philosopher asked: what is matter made of?

CH25.name: Organic Synthesis Attempt

EL04.name: Telegraph
EL04.fx: Telegraph Office [160/1; +1 Gold; cityStrength +3; +1 Gold from each Trade Route].

EL09.fx: Radio Transmitter [250/1; New Military units start with 15 XP in this city; +25% spy effectiveness in this city (<when espionage is enabled>)]. Prerequisite for Radio and the Internet. EL11.fx: +1 Production in all cities connected to capital (a lossless grid); +1 Happiness in all cities <in cities with a Hospital> (imaging). Prerequisite for Fusion and some FTL paths.

EL12.fx: +2 Production in all cities connected to capital; +1 Movement <for Civilian units> (maglev). Also reachable through Electronics or Materials Science.

EN09.fx: +2 Science from all Fab buildings; +2 Science from all Research Lab buildings — memory that needs no power.

EN11.name: Radio
EN11.fx: Broadcast Tower; Eiffel Tower (world wonder); National Intelligence Agency (national wonder). CP01.fx: +10% Strength <for Siege units> (ballistics). CP13.fx: +10% Strength <for Siege units> <before discovering Programmable Computer>; +10% Strength <for Water units> <when attacking> <before discovering Programmable Computer> (fire-control computers); +1 Science from all Observatory buildings <before discovering Programmable Computer>. CP16.name: Planetary Data Networks

QP05.fx: +10% Insight to Electronics; prerequisite for the FTL paths, the Ion Drive and Metamaterials. Mirrored by Unified Field Theory.

QP10.fx: Mutually exclusive with QP09 — discreteness excludes extra dimensions.

QP12.fx: Prerequisite for Wormhole FTL and Zero-Point Energy. Mirrored by Aetheric Vacuum. Its report concerns vacuum energy, not the FTL method.
